page_title: AST 3-1 FUL | Aston Villa v Fulham 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
90+1' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Aston Villa keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
86' Fulham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
85' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Antonee Robinson (Fulham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
83' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Evann Guessand is replaced by Donyell Malen (Aston Villa).
82' Substitution. Lamare Bogarde makes his way off the pitch and Victor Lindelof (Aston Villa) comes on as his replacement.
82' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
80' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Harry Wilson and he is replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham).
80' That's the end of the game for Ryan Sessegnon, who is replaced by Antonee Robinson (Fulham).
79' A corner kick by Fulham is thwarted by the well prepared Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa).
79' Adama Traore (Fulham) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
77' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bernd Leno intercepts the ball.
73' Kevin (Fulham) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
72' A substitution has been made. John McGinn goes off and Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) comes on.
69' A pass into the penalty area from Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is intercepted by the defence.
65' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Joshua King will be replaced by Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham).
65' Kevin comes onto the pitch after Alex Iwobi (Fulham) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
64' The ball is cleared after Joshua King (Fulham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
62' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
60' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 4:4.
55' The referee is firm and issues Calvin Bassey (Fulham) a deserved yellow card.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing.
54' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
54' One of the Aston Villa players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
51' 3 - 1 Goal! Morgan Rogers provides Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the left post. 3:1.
49' 2 - 1 Goal! John McGinn (Aston Villa) is teed up on the edge of the box by Emiliano Buendia, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 2:1.
48' Great teamplay by Aston Villa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
47' The game is interrupted as Adama Traore (Fulham) is flagged offside.
46' Unai Emery has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) comes on the pitch for Harvey Elliott.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+9' Andy Madley has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' The corner kick from Harry Wilson (Fulham) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
45+4' John McGinn (Aston Villa) picked up a yellow card from referee.
45+4' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45+3' Harry Wilson (Fulham) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
45+1' Harry Wilson (Fulham) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.

44' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

43' Joshua King (Fulham) rises high to head a nice lofted cross low towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Emiliano Martinez makes a comfortable save.
43' Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) jumps into a tackle and Andy Madley signals a foul. Fulham are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
41' Harry Wilson (Fulham) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
37' 1 - 1 GOAL! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Bernd Leno, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:1.
37' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
34' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
33' Here comes a substitution. Pau Torres (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Tyrone Mings.
30' Harry Wilson (Fulham) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
28' The game is interrupted now, Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' One of the players from Fulham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
26' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
25' Fulham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
25' Surely that's handball by one of the Aston Villa players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
24' Joshua King (Fulham) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Joshua King (Fulham) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
20' The Fulham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

18' John McGinn (Aston Villa) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
17' The resulting set piece from Aston Villa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

17' Harvey Elliott (Aston Villa) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Aston Villa will take a corner.
16' John McGinn (Aston Villa) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
16' Evann Guessand (Aston Villa) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
15' Harry Wilson (Fulham) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
14' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Bernd Leno, who smothers the ball.

13' Joshua King (Fulham) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Emiliano Martinez makes a great save to stop the effort going low into the middle of the goal.
12' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
11' Problems for Marco Silva as Raul Jimenez is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Adama Traore (Fulham) replaces him.
9' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
7' Evann Guessand (Aston Villa) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
6' Andy Madley sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
5' Wait! Referee Andy Madley has indicated he is going to review the Fulham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
3' 0 - 1 Raul Jimenez (Fulham) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
3' The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
3' Joshua King (Fulham) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Fulham will have the kick-off.
Andy Madley is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
